_doc: Anti-legacy pattern catalogue. A pattern is not forbidden; if present it needs an ADR by the justification owner. Checked by K-LEGACY at G2 and S1–S4.

patterns.detection: one function calls subsystems in order each frame
patterns.default_stance: Task graph of phases with derived ordering (C-FRAME)

patterns.detection: tick functions on objects/components
patterns.default_stance: Scheduled systems with declared access; opt-in budgeted ticks

patterns.detection: named long-lived render thread
patterns.default_stance: Render work as tasks in overlapping task-graph frames; dedicated threads only by ADR (thread inventory in CORE.JOBS.thread-model)

patterns.detection: UI, scripting or platform callbacks require the OS main thread
patterns.default_stance: PAL isolates OS-thread-bound APIs behind queues

patterns.detection: Actor→Pawn→Character chains
patterns.default_stance: Composition of components/systems + services

patterns.detection: universal possession concept
patterns.default_stance: Control binding as data, chosen per game by ADR

patterns.detection: one tree holds the world
patterns.default_stance: Partitioned data-oriented world; hierarchy only for attachment

patterns.detection: static instances initialized implicitly
patterns.default_stance: Service registry + init graph

patterns.detection: cvar reads inside parallel tasks
patterns.default_stance: Immutable config snapshots latched at sync points

patterns.detection: virtual call per draw/body/query
patterns.default_stance: Batch-granular interfaces; binding at build/load time

patterns.detection: mutex around a subsystem; renderer-wide flush
patterns.default_stance: Declared access, channels, lock-free where justified (renderer sync: L28)

patterns.pattern: Draw-call-centric CPU submission on capable tiers
patterns.detection: one CPU draw per object on desktop/console
patterns.default_stance: GPU-driven on capable tiers; CPU-batched on TBDR/lite3d by ADR

patterns.detection: slot binding, immediate context, driver-managed hazards
patterns.default_stance: Binding tiers + render-graph-derived barriers

patterns.detection: proxy objects created/synced per object per frame
patterns.default_stance: Change-tracked delta extraction, O(changes)

patterns.detection: resources freed at end of frame/level
patterns.default_stance: Explicit lifetimes + retirement keyed to completion tokens

patterns.detection: file read on a frame-critical thread
patterns.default_stance: Async staged pipeline with deadlines

patterns.detection: mmap reads on latency-critical workers
patterns.default_stance: Explicit IO requests; mmap only prefetched/tool-side

patterns.detection: whole level loaded before play
patterns.default_stance: Async non-blocking loading; cell streaming with budgeted activation for 3D/openworld

patterns.pattern: Immediate synchronous observer callbacks across subsystems
patterns.detection: callbacks invoked on the producer's thread mid-update
patterns.default_stance: Deferred batched events at declared consumption points

patterns.detection: name lookups per frame
patterns.default_stance: Static reflection & resolved IDs; strings at tool/script boundaries

patterns.detection: engine objects reachable via GC
patterns.default_stance: Explicit ownership + generational handles; weak script refs

patterns.pattern: Global script VM on one thread
patterns.detection: single interpreter mutating the world
patterns.default_stance: Per-worker VMs/isolates, deferred mutation

patterns.detection: editor code linked into shipping builds
patterns.default_stance: Tool-side modules; tools target only

patterns.detection: full cook required before running
patterns.default_stance: On-demand cooking & cook-server streaming

patterns.detection: systems that must run serially by construction
patterns.default_stance: Parallel by construction, correct on one worker (inline mode)

patterns.detection: one module owning a whole domain
patterns.default_stance: Contracts + focused experts

patterns.pattern: ECS for everything / GPU-driven everywhere (new dogma)
patterns.detection: technique applied where access patterns do not fit
patterns.default_stance: Per-domain ADR with workload evidence

patterns.detection: WaitForIdle / flush calls on frame paths
patterns.default_stance: Render-graph-derived barriers; external work imported with queue transfers

patterns.pattern: Runtime shader/PSO compilation on first use
patterns.detection: PSO created on first draw; hitch on new material
patterns.default_stance: PSO coverage from play traces, precompiled/pipeline libraries, async creation with fallbacks

patterns.detection: simulation stepped by render delta
patterns.default_stance: Fixed/declared step with interpolation per C-FRAME

patterns.detection: loading one asset pulls large dependency closures
patterns.default_stance: Soft references, dependency-aware loading with budgets

patterns.detection: static world accessor
patterns.default_stance: World handles; multiple isolated worlds

patterns.detection: shadow-state comparison per object per connection
patterns.default_stance: Push/dirty tracking, serialize once, O(changes)

patterns.pattern: Global shared RNG used from parallel tasks
patterns.detection: one generator object shared by jobs
patterns.default_stance: Counter-based / per-stream RNG for parallel determinism

patterns.detection: property paths resolved and evaluated every frame
patterns.default_stance: Change-notified view models with resolved bindings

patterns.pattern: Per-body sync callbacks & mid-step world mutation
patterns.detection: O(bodies) transform write-back; queries mid-step
patterns.default_stance: Active-set/change-set output, batched queries, deferred commands

patterns.detection: synchronous import/save/compile/bake on the editor UI thread
patterns.default_stance: Asynchronous, cancellable editor jobs with progress

patterns.detection: whole-object serialization per transaction
patterns.default_stance: Serializable, diff-based commands

patterns.detection: one binary level file edited by exclusive lock
patterns.default_stance: One-file-per-object layout with semantic merge

patterns.pattern: Editor-only data fields in runtime types
patterns.detection: editor fields compiled into runtime structs
patterns.default_stance: Editor/runtime data separation

patterns.pattern: Full re-cook or re-bake after local edits
patterns.detection: any edit triggers a full rebuild
patterns.default_stance: Incremental cooking with region invalidation, proven equal to clean cook

patterns.pattern: TCP or all-reliable channels for real-time state
patterns.detection: state over reliable ordered stream
patterns.default_stance: UDP-class channels with per-message reliability classes

patterns.detection: server trusts client results
patterns.default_stance: Server authority with bounded-rewind validation

patterns.detection: state changes sent as RPCs
patterns.default_stance: State replication plus events

patterns.detection: clients rejected on any build difference
patterns.default_stance: Compatibility windows

patterns.detection: direct P2P addressing of players
patterns.default_stance: Relay-shielded addressing

patterns.detection: no state hashing in lockstep
patterns.default_stance: State-hash desync detection & tooling

patterns.pattern: Content encryption as protection; long-lived secrets in clients
patterns.detection: pak keys or API secrets in binaries
patterns.default_stance: Server-held secrets, short-lived tokens, signing with custody

patterns.detection: client grants purchases
patterns.default_stance: Server-side verification & transactions

patterns.detection: mods load native code without opt-in
patterns.default_stance: Sandboxed by default; native only by explicit opt-in; signed distribution

patterns.pattern: Hand-written parsers of hostile input without hardening
patterns.detection: unfuzzed C/C++ parser of network/UGC data
patterns.default_stance: Registered untrusted input, fuzzed, hardened or memory-safe parser

patterns.detection: console/ports/live coding present in shipping binaries
patterns.default_stance: Dev-surface manifest, exclusion fitness function & binary scan

patterns.detection: default hash on untrusted keys
patterns.default_stance: Keyed hashing

patterns.detection: telemetry without data classes or minimization
patterns.default_stance: Data inventory, sensitivity classes, minimization & consent

patterns.pattern: Kernel-mode anti-cheat as the default posture
patterns.detection: kernel driver required by default
patterns.default_stance: Server authority, attestation and user-mode anti-cheat first

patterns.detection: tests written after features by their implementer
patterns.default_stance: Oracles by declared oracle authors, tests before features

patterns.pattern: Wall-clock time and exact-pixel goldens in tests
patterns.detection: sleeps, real clocks, bit-exact images across GPUs
patterns.default_stance: Injectable clocks, perceptual metrics with per-GPU tolerances

patterns.detection: bloom, DOF or motion blur after tonemapping; 8-bit intermediate targets on HDR-capable tiers
patterns.default_stance: Scene-referred linear HDR chain with a single output transform; only grain, dithering and UI-safe sharpening after it

patterns.pattern: Geometry shaders, HW tessellation and stream-out pipelines on capable tiers
patterns.detection: GS/HS/DS stages or stream-out in material or LOD paths
patterns.default_stance: Mesh shaders or compute expansion; cluster/displacement paths on GPU-driven tiers
